scripts.check:fast: npm run check:workspace-lock && npm run check:knowledge && npm run check:artifacts && npm run clean && npm run build && npm run test -w @unity-shader-nav/server
scripts.test: npm run check:fast && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:package && npm run test:electron:prepared
scripts.test:package: npm run package:vsix && npm run compile:tests && npm run test:package-layout
scripts.test:electron: npm run test:package && npm run test:electron:prepared
scripts.test:electron:activation: npm run test:package && npm run test:electron:harness && node tests/out/runTest.js --suite activation
scripts.test:electron:prepared: npm run test:electron:harness && node tests/out/runTest.js --suite activation && node tests/out/runTest.js --suite integration
scripts.clean: rimraf client/out server/out shared/out tests/out client/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo server/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo shared/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
